summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT with hands-on experience in computer vision, deep learning, and real-time robotics perception. Deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on a physical robotic arm and engineered a metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching and ZoeDepth 3D reconstruction (±8% depth error); custom CUDA C++ kernels achieved ~35% GPU inference speedup on NVIDIA Jetson.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis: custom image stitching (PSNR 86 vs. 65 baseline), wavelet denoising (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5), and ZoeDepth 3D reconstruction at ±8% depth error.
Designed data capture strategies and augmentation pipeline for multi-resolution microscopic imaging; validated inspection output on defect classification tasks.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI; built batch-loading data pipeline for 3D volumetric inputs; evaluated Dice Score and IoU across all backbones.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset; trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images achieving 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile inference deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on a physical robotic arm for vision-guided pick-and-place; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, rolling-shutter depth artifacts); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights, and preallocated buffers; achieved 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) — ~35% speedup at identical accuracy.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines (semantic segmentation + raycast occlusion) producing ~5,000 YOLO frames with zero manual annotation; trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); achieved zero collisions across Town02 with 30 vehicles.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e via ROS 2 driver with <2mm pose repeatability over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking; routed pose commands to STM32 over UART for closed-loop multi-servo control with VL53L0X ToF depth sensing and FreeRTOS task coordination.
